# Tables and figures of the IEEE paper, as tables (generated by scripts/make_report_tables.py)

Same order as docs/latex/FINAL_REPORT.tex. Tables have the paper's columns and rounding; each figure is given as a table of the numbers it plots. Every number is computed from the results of the last run (results/metrics/, results/tracks/). Figs. 1 and 9 (the architecture diagram and a frame of the output video) contain no data. Lower is better for IDSW, FP, FN and Frag; bold marks the best value.

## Table I. Datasets and how they are used

|  | SportsMOT | UVY-Track | InFactory Soccer Ball Tracking |
|---|---|---|---|
| Footage | Professional broadcast (football, basketball, volleyball) | User-generated online sports videos, seven sports | Professional soccer broadcast |
| Annotation format | MOT Challenge text | MOT-style text with a class column | YOLO text, one file per frame |
| Annotated objects | Players on the pitch only | Player, goalkeeper, referee, sports ball, goal, camera | Ball only, plus frames marked "ball not visible" |
| Persistent identities | Players | People and ball | None |
| Role in this work | Player tracking (tuning and test) | Player tracking and ball detection/tracking (test) | Ball detection (test) |
| Subset used | 4 football sequences of the validation split | 3 soccer sequences | 10 clips (884 frames with a visible ball, 566 without) |

| OC-SORT | 59.3 | 55.3 | 61.2 |
| ByteTrack (proposed) | 62.6 | 52.6 | 66.8 |

| Tracker | OWTA | AssA | DetRe |

| SORT | 56.1 | 58.2 | 56.4 |
| OC-SORT | 54.3 | 53.9 | 57.6 |
| ByteTrack (proposed) | 56.8 | 57.3 | 58.7 |
